briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4.5 escalate multi-agent race as US export controls tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released three major models this week while compute shortages persist. US-China tensions drive new export rules on advanced chips. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation gains traction in enterprise pilots.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic released Claude 4.5 Opus; Google DeepMind previewed Gemini 3.0. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B variant. xAI Grok-3 training cluster now at 200k H100s.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agent-to-agent attacks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Oracle announced joint 500MW Texas data center; TSMC 2nm yield issues delay Nvidia Blackwell shipments. Saudi Arabia commits $40B to sovereign AI cluster.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards emerge before state actors weaponize autonomous AI swarms?
